module: "Props Touch" node (category `repeat_instant`, tags collision/collide/hit). Tells whether a vehicle touches an object (prop) from a list of ids, via `map.objects[vehId].objectCollisions`. Input pins: `flow`, `vehId`, `propsIds` (table of ids). Outputs: `flow` (true), `touching` (flow), `isTouching` (bool, hidden).

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by `_flowgraph_createNode(C)`). Definition fields: name, description, category, pinSchema, tags.

work.desc: Iterates over `propsIds` and sets `touching` / `isTouching` on the first colliding object.
